G1_unambiguity.justification: The hyperplane definition and the universal condition on valid state vectors precisely specify when the critical indices must be equal.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement provides all necessary bounds, input details, costs, structural conditions, output requirements, and edge cases.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Activating a mechanism enforces equality of the corresponding components, and the full-rigidity condition with exactly n−1 mechanisms is equivalent to the original tree, so the optimization problem is unchanged.

G4_naturalness.justification: The formulation is coherent and idiomatic, though its abstract linear-algebra framing is more elaborate than necessary for the underlying tree-cabling problem.
